## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS
- **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. No `<style>` blocks in the HTML, no presentational attributes.
- **Class/ID Selectors Only:** Every visual property, layout rule, and state must live in `style.css`, targeted via class or ID selectors.
- **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML stays clean, semantic, and style-agnostic. Re-theming the page must be possible by editing `style.css` alone.

### 1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens
Define all tokens in `:root` (dark values as default) and override them in `:root.light` / via a `.light` class on `<html>`. Use this exact token set:

**Dark theme (flagship):**
- **Backgrounds:** `--bg-primary: #0a0510`, `--bg-secondary: #1a0f2e`, `--bg-tertiary: #2a1a45`
- **Brand:** `--primary: #ccff00` (acid chrome green), `--secondary: #ff2ee0` (magenta), `--accent-toxic: #7cff2e`
- **Text:** `--text-primary: #eafff0`, `--text-secondary: rgba(234, 255, 240, 0.68)`, `--text-success: #7cff2e`, `--text-error: #ff4d8f`
- **Borders:** `--border-default: rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.35)`, `--border-strong: #ccff00`, `--border-error: #ff4d8f`, `--border-success: #7cff2e`
- **Shadows (neon glow):** `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 10px rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.18)`; `--shadow-md: 0 8px 28px rgba(255, 46, 224, 0.25), 0 0 0 1px rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.15)`; `--shadow-lg: 0 18px 48px rgba(124, 255, 46, 0.22), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 46, 224, 0.2)`
- **Body background:** `--bg-image: radial-gradient(140% 100% at 10% -10%, #2a1a45 0%, #0a0510 55%, #150826 100%)` (fixed attachment)

**Light theme overrides:**
- **Backgrounds:** `--bg-primary: #f2ffe8` (acid-wash mint — never `#ffffff`), `--bg-secondary: #fefefe`, `--bg-tertiary: #e4f7cf`
- **Text:** `--text-primary: #0a0510`, `--text-secondary: rgba(10, 5, 16, 0.68)`, `--text-success: #2f7d00`, `--text-error: #d6006b`
- **Borders:** `--border-default: rgba(85, 135, 11, 0.38)`, `--border-strong: #6b9900`, `--border-error: #d6006b`, `--border-success: #2f7d00`
- **Shadows:** softened neon equivalents (e.g., `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 10px rgba(85, 135, 11, 0.15)`; keep the same structure with lighter alphas)
- **Neon usage rule:** `#ccff00`, `#ff2ee0`, and `#7cff2e` remain unchanged in light mode for **fills, gradients, and decorative surfaces only**, always paired with dark text (`#0a0510`). Neon colors must **never** be used as text color or thin borders on light backgrounds.

**Shared tokens:**
- **Radii:** `--radius-sm: 4px`, `--radius-md: 10px`, `--radius-lg: 18px`, `--radius-pill: 999px`
- **Spacing:** `--spacing-gap: 24px`, plus a full scale (`--space-1: 4px` through `--space-24: 96px`)
- **Type scale:** fluid `clamp()`-based `--text-xs` (0.75rem) through `--text-5xl` (4rem)
- **Transitions:** `--transition-fast: 140ms`, `--transition-normal: 320ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.2, 1.4)`, `--ease-entrance: cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1)`, `--ease-exit: cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 1, 1)`
- **Stacking:** `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-sticky: 200`, `--z-modal: 300`, `--z-toast: 400`
- **Signature extras:** `--chrome-gradient: linear-gradient(120deg, #eafff0 0%, #ccff00 22%, #ff2ee0 50%, #7cff2e 74%, #eafff0 100%)`; `--warp: skewY(-1.4deg) rotate(-0.6deg)`

**Mandatory contrast pairing:** every light background token pairs with dark text tokens, every dark background token pairs with light text tokens — enforced in **both** themes, not just the default.

**Chrome border technique note:** `border-image` ignores `border-radius`. For gradient ("chrome") borders on rounded components, use the double-background technique instead: `background: linear-gradient(var(--bg-secondary), var(--bg-secondary)) padding-box, var(--chrome-gradient) border-box; border: 2px solid transparent;`.

### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support
- **Implementation:** Dark is the flagship theme. Apply themes by toggling a class on `<html>`; also provide a `@media (prefers-color-scheme: ...)` fallback for first visits with no stored preference.
- **Seamless Switching:** All backgrounds/text/borders must flip via CSS variables only — zero HTML restructuring on toggle.
- **Persistence:** Store the user's choice in `localStorage`; on load, read `localStorage` first, then fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`, then default to dark. Include a visible toggle button in the nav (Google Material Symbols `dark_mode` / `light_mode` icons) with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Toggle dark mode") that updates per state.

### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment
- **Flexbox everywhere** for all layout structures.
- **Default Alignment Rule:** every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless a specific exception is justified in a CSS comment (e.g., top-aligned card content stacks).
- **Mobile-First:** build column layouts first, then enhance to rows at breakpoints (`~768px`, `~1024px`). **No horizontal scrolling at any viewport width from 360px up** — critical with skewed/warped elements: wrap warped panels in `overflow: hidden` containers and set `overflow-x: clip` on `body`.

### 1.5 CSS Organization & Naming
- Use clean **custom CSS** (no framework) organized in a fixed order: tokens → base/reset → layout → components → sections → utilities.
- **BEM naming only** (`block`, `block__element`, `block--modifier`, e.g., `.btn--primary`, `.card--featured`, `pricing__tier`). Never mix conventions.

### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)
- **Text fonts:** load via Google Fonts `<link>` (with `preconnect`): **Space Grotesk** (body → `--font-base`), **Archivo Black** (display headlines → `--font-display`, substituting for the unavailable "Chrome" face in the source spec), **JetBrains Mono** (eyebrow labels, prices, meta → `--font-mono`).
- **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Rounded) only. **Raw inline SVGs, local icon files, and emoji-as-icons are forbidden.**
- **Melted chrome type:** apply `var(--chrome-gradient)` to display headlines via `background-clip: text; color: transparent;` (with `-webkit-` prefixes and a solid `--text-primary` fallback), plus a subtle glow via `filter: drop-shadow(...)`. Optional slow `background-position` drift animation — gated by `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

### 2.1 Button Component (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--danger`)
All states via CSS classes:
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px. `.btn--primary`: chrome gradient background, dark text `#0a0510`, 2px dark border, `--radius-md`. `.btn--ghost`: `--bg-tertiary` background, `--border-strong` border, `--text-primary` text.
- **Hover:** `transform: var(--warp) translateY(-2px)` + `--shadow-md` + `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus-visible:** distinct 3px outline in `--secondary` with 3px offset — visible in both themes.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` click feedback.
- **Loading:** class-based state that disables interaction and prevents double-clicks (`aria-busy="true"`, pointer-events suppressed), rendering a spinning Material Symbol (`progress_activity`) via CSS rotation **without changing button dimensions**.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`, transforms removed.
- **Success/Error:** transient feedback styling driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`, announced via an `aria-live="polite"` region.

### 2.2 Card Component (`.card`)
- **Default:** flex layout, `--bg-secondary` background, `--radius-lg`, chrome gradient border via the double-background technique, `--shadow-md`, `transform: var(--warp)` on featured/raised cards only (contained so it cannot cause overflow).
- **Hover:** `translateY(-2px)` + `--shadow-lg`.
- **Focus-within:** border/glow highlight when a child link or button receives focus (entire card becomes the target affordance).
- **Loading (Skeleton):** define a `.card--skeleton` shimmer keyframe animation that preserves exact layout dimensions; disabled under reduced motion.
- **Empty State:** define a structured fallback pattern — large Material Symbol + one line of guidance text — available as classes.

### 2.3 Form & Input Component (newsletter signup in Final CTA)
- **States:** empty, focused (accent ring via `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 46, 224, 0.35)` in dark; theme-appropriate equivalent in light), filled, valid (success border + `check` Material Symbol), invalid (error border, `--text-error` message text, `error` icon), disabled, read-only — all styled via classes.
- **Structure:** flex container (label, input, dedicated `.form__error` feedback container). Error messages live in the dedicated container with `aria-live="polite"`; never communicate validity by color alone (always icon + text). Label bound via `for`/`id`. Submit button implements the full 2.1 state set including loading and success feedback.

### 2.4 FAQ Accordion
- **Semantics:** each item = `<button aria-expanded>` heading + panel with `role="region"` / `aria-labelledby`; fully keyboard operable.
- **Animation:** open/close via CSS (`grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` or equivalent) using `--transition-normal`; chevron Material Symbol rotates 180° with state.
- **No mouse-only behavior**; no horizontal layout shifts on toggle.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by Default:** fluid `clamp()` typography and spacing; validate zero horizontal overflow from 360px up.
- **Smooth Animations:** every state change transitions with `var(--transition-fast)` / `var(--transition-normal)` + `--ease-standard`. One global `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block disables blob morphing, marquee, shimmer, gradient drift, spinner rotation (replace with static indicator), and warp animations.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** semantic landmarks (`header`, `nav` with `aria-label`, `main`, `section` with `aria-labelledby`, `footer`); strict heading order `h1 → h2 → h3`; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability (nav, toggle, accordion, form, all CTAs); `aria-live` regions for form errors and button success/loading feedback; sufficient contrast in **both** themes (forbidden combinations: neon text on light backgrounds, `--text-secondary` below readable contrast); never rely on color alone for any state.
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, focus, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive/Danger Actions:** if any destructive control appears (e.g., form reset), style `.btn--danger` as visually distinct via `--text-error` / `--border-error` in **both** themes.

- **File Structure:** three separate files — `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. Only a single deferred `<script src="script.js" defer>` reference in the HTML; no inline script logic, no inline styles.
- **JavaScript scope (vanilla only):** theme toggle with `localStorage` persistence + `prefers-color-scheme` fallback (1.3); FAQ accordion state handling; newsletter validation with success/error states wired to the `aria-live` region and button loading/success states; optional `IntersectionObserver` scroll-reveal gated by reduced motion. Nothing else.
- **Naming Convention:** BEM exclusively, across HTML and CSS.
- **No Unrequested Placeholders:** author genuine English copy for every section per the tone guide. Placeholder text is permitted only where content is genuinely unspecified.
- **Both themes fully implemented and validated** — the source spec does not declare modes, so before finishing, verify: dark default, light toggle, persistence across reload, keyboard-only walkthrough of every interactive element, and zero horizontal overflow at 360px, 768px, and 1024px.
